# createSession

commonJvmAndroid

suspend override fun [createSession](create-session.html)(key: [SessionKey](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-key/index.html), state: [Map](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-map/index.html)<[String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), [Any](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-any/index.html)>? = null): [Session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/index.html)

Creates a new session with the specified parameters.

#### Return

The newly created [Session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/index.html) instance.

#### Parameters

 _key_

The composite identifier of the session. If [SessionKey.id](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-key/id.html) is null, the service generates a unique session id and the returned [Session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/index.html) will reflect it.

_state_

An optional map representing the initial state of the session.

#### Throws

[SessionException](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-exception/index.html)

with [SessionException.SESSION_ALREADY_EXISTS](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-exception/-companion/-s-e-s-s-i-o-n_-a-l-r-e-a-d-y_-e-x-i-s-t-s.html) if a session already exists under [SessionKey.id](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-key/id.html) for this app and user. An existing session is never overwritten. A service backed by a managed remote store may surface that backend's own error instead.
